notes.title: Twinkle Stardust's Catnap Chaos - Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Improved clarity of some tutorials
[*] Fix an issue where entity speeds could get stuck slower or faster
[*] Adjusted hitboxes to reduce accidental purchases 
[*] Allow analog stick control of UI
[*] Fix credits scaling on certain resolutions
[*] Save and quit now returns to main menu
[*] Fixed music looping issue
[*] Difficulty adjustments
[*] Fix health bars getting out of sync
[*] Fix bug where bumped thief mouse's item got lost
[*] Fix bug where mouse control wouldn't work in pause menu if playing on controller
[*] Fixed an issue with some settings not being saved
[*] Fix minor visual glitches
[/list]
